chunks: As for what al-Husayn ibn Sa'id narrated from Muhammad ibn Abi 'Umayr, from Jamil ibn Salih, from 'Abd al-Malik ibn 'Amr, who said:
I said to Abu 'Abdillah عليه السلام: Is the qunut of الجمعة in the first rak'ah before the ruku' and in the second after it? He said to me: Neither before nor after.

key_terms.بَعْدَهُ: after it, meaning after the ruku'
key_terms.قُنُوتُ: the qunut supplication performed in salat

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on the qunut in salat al-jumu'ah according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith addresses a fiqh ruling concerning qunut in salat al-jumu'ah. The Imam عليه السلام rejects the described placement of qunut, indicating that it is not to be performed in the manner mentioned in the question.
